stem: Two hydroponic zones share the same reservoir, but one repeatedly shows weaker growth. Which investigation best isolates a system-level cause?
choices: Compare delivered flow, return flow, root-zone temperature and oxygen conditions by zone before changing reservoir chemistry
Increase nutrients for the entire reservoir immediately
Change cultivar names in the records
Raise light intensity in both zones
rationale: Shared chemistry does not guarantee identical delivery or root-zone conditions; zone-level hydraulic and environmental measurements isolate the difference.
